messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — Customer `tenant-42` reporting intermittent 403s when doing a batch inference -> embeddings -> rerank chain. Started ~today after they rotated a service key via SSO provisioner. Error only when requests include a batched embeddings call followed by a rerank POST.
Maria Gonzalez: Ugh. Do we have a repro? any request IDs or example payloads?
Alex Chen: Repro steps I got from customer: 1) create service key via SSO UI (team-scoped) 2) use same key for both /v1/embeddings (batch) and /v1/rerank 3) rerank returns 403 with body: `{ "error": "insufficient_scope", "message": "missing:rerank" }` but embeddings succeed.
Alex Chen: Example curl they sent: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY" -d '{"model":"embed-compact","input":["a","b"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings && \
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY" -d '{"model":"rerank-small","query":"a","documents":["b"]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
Maria Gonzalez: Interesting that embeddings returns 200 and rerank 403. Could be the provisioner granting embeddings but not rerank scope, or a token scoping bug for multi-call sessions.
Devlin Park: Can you paste the response headers from the 403? sometimes we surface `x-auth-scope` header that shows the scopes attached to the key. Also which auth backend: SSO-provisioner v2?
Alex Chen: I'll ask for headers. They said provisioner v2. Quick logs from gateway show: `auth: validate_key key_id=sk_abc123 scopes=[embeddings,generation] result=allow` then `auth: route_check required=rerank key_id=sk_abc123 result=deny`.
Devlin Park: That log is telling — key only has embeddings+generation, missing rerank. But why would the UI create a key without rerank for that team? Is default scope policy supposed to include rerank for service keys?
Simon Lee: Default policy changed last month: org-level service keys no longer get rerank by default unless team policy includes "advanced-llm". Migration might have missed tenant-42.
Jess Ramos: Customer onboarding note: tenant-42 was created before the policy change and we auto-migrated keys, but SSO-provisioner opt-in step was manual; sounds like this key was created post-rotation and didn't get opt-in.
Maria Gonzalez: Proposed fix for now: ask customer to re-provision the key with explicit `rerank` scope (or use an org admin to add scope). Could we also provide a short repro that they can run to validate?
Devlin Park: Yes. Quick check command for them: ```bash
curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/_auth/inspect
# Look for: x-auth-scopes: embeddings,generation,rerank
```
Alex Chen: I sent that command, they replied: header shows `x-auth-scopes: embeddings,generation` only.
Simon Lee: Ok, root cause confirmed: missing rerank scope on the key. Action items: 1) CS asks customer to rotate/create a new key with explicit `rerank` scope or have admin update policy; 2) Support provides temporary workaround: call rerank using a different key with rerank permission (if available) or run rerank via hosted endpoint that allows session-scoped escalation (we might not want to recommend that publicly); 3) Engineering: consider adding a warning in SSO-provisioner UI when team policy omits rerank for keys created in orgs that previously had rerank.
Jess Ramos: I'll draft the customer message and include the quick `curl -I` check + exact wording for the SSO UI steps. Want review before I send.
Maria Gonzalez: Also include a note to check automated CI/service accounts; we saw one case where CI rotations used the new policy and failed silently.
Devlin Park: From eng side, I'll open a ticket to add a gate in the provisioner to either copy legacy scopes on rotate or require explicit confirmation. Ticket: ENG-ww-1425.
ops-bot: Incident created ENG-ww-1425: "SSO provisioner: Add scope confirmation on key rotate" assigned to eng-oncall.
Alex Chen: Customer responded — they'll repro after creating new key and confirm. I'll update thread when they do. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks. If they hit any 403 with `missing:rerank` after providing a key with rerank scope, ping me and I'll escalate.
Devlin Park: One more note — let's monitor for bulk rotate jobs that might hit the new policy; could be multiple tenants affected. I'll add a query to the dashboard for 403s with `missing:rerank`.
Alex Chen: Closing loop for now. Will post updates. (reacted with :eyes:)
